## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: vehicle equipment and defensive driving
Knowledge facts: part C holds 39 fact blocks (sec11-F01 onward) from physical pages 68 to 71; part C2 holds 11 confusable-pair blocks (sec11-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-EQP-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-EQP-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-EQP-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the fuel cost and savings estimates (for example sec11-F22 and sec11-F25) are economic figures that can change and must be refreshed from the official source.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
